subject: Joint Inspection Request: Underground water leakage undermining road sub-grade at Naubasta Main
body: This is to bring to your urgent attention that subterranean pipeline seepage at Naubasta Main Road (near Chowk Turn) is persistently degrading the newly laid bitumen crust. You are requested to depute an Assistant Engineer for a Joint Inspection on 24-Feb-2026 at 11:00 AM so pipeline repair precedes road restoration.

subject: Encroachment Removal & Stormwater Drain Clearance along Shaheed Path Corridor
body: Multiple citizen grievances filed on Nirikshan indicate unauthorized vending sheds obstructing primary stormwater arterial drains. As per Section 133 CrPC and Municipal Bylaws, you are hereby instructed to initiate a coordinated anti-encroachment drive with Lucknow Police within 48 hours.
